```{r}

load("12_DataSaving.RData")
```

```{r}
#23/24 Data Cleaning Steps

nba_raw <- read.csv("23_24_Height.csv")
dim(nba_raw)

nba <- nba_raw[, c("PLAYER", "TEAM", "AGE", "HEIGHT", "WEIGHT", "GP", "PTS")]
colSums(is.na(nba))
nba$TEAM <- as.factor(nba$TEAM)
str(nba)

nba$height_cm <- height_to_cm(nba$HEIGHT)
nba$elite     <- nba$PTS >= 25
summary(nba$height_cm)
table(nba$elite)  

elite <- filter_elite(nba, threshold = 25)
nrow(elite)  

save(nba, elite, file = "12_DataSaving.RData")




```


```{r}
#25/26 Data Cleaning Steps:

stat_data$PLAYER <- toupper(trimws(stat_data$PLAYER))
general_data$PLAYER <- toupper(trimws(general_data$PLAYER))

df <- merge(stat_data, general_data[, c("PLAYER","HEIGHT")], by="PLAYER")

# Convert height like "7-4" to inches
df$HT <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(df$HEIGHT), "-"), function(x)
  as.numeric(x[1])*12 + as.numeric(x[2]))

df <- df[df$GP >= 20 & !is.na(df$HT), ]
```
